title: setup --help and setup hook --help print the usage on stdout and exit 0
source: intended: docs/decisions.md D8 (setup hook, defect N-17): jitso registers its guard in the project's .claude/settings.json without clobbering anything
intent: INTENDED behavior (defect N-17, setup hook). `jitso setup --help` and `jitso setup hook --help` (and `-h`) print the usage with the flags `--harness`, `--absolute`, `--remove`, `--force`, `--dry-run` and `--yes` on stdout, empty stderr, exit 0; nothing is written.

stdout: --scope     project (default): this checkout; user: your own sessions, in every folder
--harness   claude, codex, opencode, pi as a comma list, or all (default: each one on PATH; claude when none is)
--absolute  write this binary's absolute path instead of the word jitso
--remove    remove the hook entries jitso added
--force     replace or remove a guard file jitso did not generate (a backup is kept)
--yes       apply without asking (needed when stdin is not a terminal)
